summary.text: A centaur who fell before Peirithous at the wedding war, paired with Lycus in Ovid's narration.

story.text: Nestor's tale in Ovid has Lycus and Chromis fall before Pirithous when the centaurs were driven back — their deaths counted as less glorious than the javelin that pierced Helops or the cliff-death of Dictys on the ash tree.
